author: Chase Davis
title: Jimmy Crooks III pops pinch-hit game-winning homer
desc: Jimmy Crooks III went 1-for-1 in a win over Atlanta with a home run, a run scored and one RBI.
impact: After Friday's win, Crooks is batting .172 across 24 games with two homers, eight RBI, and three runs scored. The playing time has been very sporadic, but he cashed in after the long rain delay.

author: Chase Davis
title: JoJo Romero keeps it clean in narrow win
desc: JoJo Romero struck out one batter in a scoreless appearance during Friday's 2-1 win over Atlanta.
impact: After the win, Romero now has a 3.43 ERA and 1.29 WHIP with a 9.2 K/9, no saves, two blown saves and 21 holds across 43 appearances. He leads the Cardinals in holds and appearances out of the bullpen.

author: Chase Davis
title: Riley O'Brien slams door for save No. 23
desc: Riley O'Brien struck out two batters in a scoreless outing to earn the save in Friday's 2-1 win over the Braves.
impact: After Friday's win, O'Brien now has a 3.52 ERA and 1.12 WHIP with 23 saves, four blown saves and one hold across 38 appearances. He's tied with Mason Miller and Jhoan Duran for third in saves behind Cade Smith and Bryan Baker.

author: Chase Davis
title: Kyle Leahy keeps it clean in three scoreless frames vs. Braves
desc: Kyle Leahy allowed no runs on one hit and no walks while striking out two over three innings in Friday's win over the Braves.
impact: Leahy's start was shortened due to rain, and will be the last action of his first half. After the 2-1 victory, he now has a 3.73 ERA and 1.41 WHIP with a 7-4 record across 18 starts.

author: Chase Davis
title: Andy Pages pops a homer, but Dodgers get thumped
desc: Andy Pages went 3-for-4 in a loss to the Diamondbacks with a home run, a run scored, and one RBI.
impact: After the loss, Pages is batting .269 with 17 home runs, 65 RBI, 55 runs scored and eight stolen bases through 94 games. He's tied for eighth in the league with Sal Stewart of the Reds in total RBI. What a first half for him.

author: Chase Davis
title: Shohei Ohtani goes deep, but Dodgers get thumped in Arizona
desc: Shohei Ohtani went 1-for-4 in Friday's 9-3 loss to the Diamondbacks with a solo home run, one run scored, one RBI and two strikeouts.
impact: On the same day he was scratched from his last start of the first half, Ohtani proved he's healthy enough to provide a big swing. After Friday's loss to Arizona, he is batting .290 with 21 home runs, 57 RBI, 63 runs scored and six stolen bases across 86 games. He also has a 1.79 ERA, 0.95 WHIP and 10.0 K/9 across 85.2 innings pitched.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Wyatt Langford goes deep as Rangers handle Astros
desc: Wyatt Langford went 1-for-3 in a win over the Astros with a solo home run, one walk, and two runs scored.
impact: Langford has picked up where he left off since returning from injury, driving in runs in each of his last two contests. The outfielder offers manager Skip Schumaker one of the more dynamic options in an inconsistent Rangers lineup, carrying an .830 OPS with nine home runs, 22 RBI, 25 runs scored, and six stolen bases across 42 games.

author: Chase Davis
title: Will Klein's command wavers in Dodgers' loss to Arizona
desc: Will Klein allowed one earned run on no hits and two walks while striking out two batters over 1.1 innings, taking the loss in Friday's game to the Diamondbacks.
impact: After Friday's game, Klein now has a 2.41 ERA and 1.37 WHIP with 2 saves and 12 holds across 32 appearances. He followed Kyle Hurt in the bullpen game, and the Diamondbacks made it difficult for him.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jake Burger drives in four in win over Astros
desc: Jake Burger went 1-for-4 in Friday's 7-3 win over the Astros with a home run, one run scored, and four RBI.
impact: Burger has heated up at the plate of late, picking up hits in four of his last five contests. The 30-year-old has flashed an explosive bat while remaining another streaky option in the Rangers lineup for manager Skip Schumaker, slashing .244 with 16 homers, 58 RBI, 41 runs scored, and two stolen bases across 90 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Joc Pederson goes yard in win over Astros
desc: Joc Pederson went 1-for-2 in Friday's 7-3 win over the Astros with a solo home run and one walk.
impact: Pederson has flashed his power stroke of late, homering in six of his last 13 contests. The 34-year-old has struggled to produce consistently despite his explosive potential in the Rangers lineup for much of the season however, slashing .237 with 15 home runs, 32 RBI, 35 runs scored, and one stolen base across 86 games.

author: Chase Davis
title: Kyle Hurt gets tagged for two runs in loss to Arizona
desc: Kyle Hurt allowed two earned runs on three hits and one walk while striking out one batter in Friday's 9-3 loss to the Diamondbacks.
impact: Serving as the opener, Hurt six hard hits and picked up four whiffs on 36 pitches. He now has a 4.88 ERA and 1.40 WHIP with a 3-1 record, 10.9 K/9, one save, and eight holds across 32 appearances.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Ezequiel Duran chips in hit, steal in win over Astros
desc: Ezequiel Duran went 1-for-3 in a win over the Astros with one walk and one stolen base.
impact: Duran continues a steady stretch at the plate, collecting hits in 10 of his last 13 contests. The infielder has provided manager Skip Schumaker with one of the more stable bats as part of a streaky Rangers lineup, batting .269 with eight home runs, 47 RBI, 37 runs scored, and seven stolen bases across 85 games.

author: Chase Davis
title: Isaac Collins homers but Royals fall short to Orioles
desc: Isaac Collins went 2-for-3 in Friday's 5-3 loss to the Orioles with a home run, a run scored and an RBI.
impact: After Friday's game, Collins is batting .242 with five home runs, 27 RBI, 35 runs scored and five stolen bases across 84 games. He's getting nearly an everyday role, but he doesn't do enough with his opportunities to matter for fantasy.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Cal Quantrill coasts through six in no-decision
desc: Cal Quantrill allowed one earned run on five hits and one walk while striking out one over six innings in Friday's win over the Astros.
impact: Quantrill continues a solid stretch on the mound of late, allowing two earned runs or less in each of his last four contests. The right-hander has offered manager Skip Schumaker one of the more stable arms as part of an inconsistent Rangers pitching staff, posting a 3.11 ERA and 1.14 WHIP with a 3-1 record and 2.2 K/BB ratio through 19 appearances.

author: Chase Davis
title: Jac Caglianone goes deep in KC loss to Baltimore
desc: Jac Caglianone went 2-for-4 in a loss to the Orioles with a home run, one run scored and one RBI.
impact: After Friday's loss, Caglianone is slashing .260/.323/.466 with 15 home runs, 35 RBI, 43 runs scored and three stolen bases across 88 games. The homer ends a 13-game power drought for the left-handed masher. Vinnie Pasquantino was activated from the IL on Friday, so Caglianone will likely move back to the outfield.
